idea.hook: Why buyers hate your chatbot (and what a well-built one does instead)

slides.heading: Why Buyers **Hate** Your Chatbot
slides.body: The AI isn't the problem. The setup is.

slides.heading: What Buyers **Actually** Want
bullets: A straight answer to 'Is it available?'

slides.heading: Feed It **Your Listings**
slides.body: Real prices, areas and availability. Not guesses.

slides.heading: Ask Like **An Agent**
slides.body: Budget, area, move-in date. One question at a time, like you would on WhatsApp.

slides.heading: Book **The Viewing**
slides.body: The goal is a date in your diary, not a long chat.

slides.heading: Hand Over **To You**
slides.body: Serious buyer or tricky question? It passes the chat to a real person.

caption:
Buyers don't hate chatbots. They hate badly built ones.

A plug-and-play bot doesn't know your listings, your prices or your areas.
A proper assistant is fed your real listings and FAQs.
It asks budget, area and move-in date, one question at a time.
It books the viewing, then hands serious buyers to you.
The AI isn't smart on its own. The system around it is.
